notes.title: Version 2.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530568/8fb702c78f6f2d044e2507cf06828bbe8be295d1.png[/img]

Version 2.5 of MechCube is available. In this update by popular demand I added the gallery of found items and endings. Now you can to replay opened endings and to read items description.

notes.title: Release 1.6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530568/8cc04f68d6ebc21934e249bd77627eeb69004b86.jpg[/img]
ːsteamhappyː The long-awaited update with new content already here! Also I fixed some minor bugs and added translates the game into the main languages. Friends, if someone want and can help me translate the game to Portuguese, please email me: coder1cv8@gmail.com.

notes.title: The long-awaited update already here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530568/bb9649050b345680fd2ebf635e18071635c7f00b.gif[/img]

In release 1.4 we added new room, new ending and a few items. Of course we're working on a way that next releases were bigger and had been more frequent. Thank you for understanding and your feedback!

notes.title: Stuck? Try to Android-version with a built-in hint system
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530568/1cb24043de3890f90c5275cb5df0919ed6e24d22.png[/img]

Stuck? No problem! Android-version of "MechCube" with a built-in hint system will help in a difficult situation! Here is the link on Google Play: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.puzzle.escape][b]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.puzzle.escape[/b][/url]
